page.layout: One printed page of text. Running head at the top. Below it: a chapter heading with a numbered list of questions (numbers at left, page references at right). A second chapter heading follows, then a second numbered list with page references at right. No notes in the margins, no catchword, no signature.

main_text.l: De ente eiusque generalissimis distributio-
nibus, CAP. III.
1 An ens possit perfecte definiri & quomodo? 28
2 An ens & essentia inter se differant & quomodo? ibid.
3 An sit discrimen inter ens & rem? 29
4 An omne ens unam duntaxat habeat essentiam? ibid.
5 An ens possit m[?]anere salvum, destructa ipsius essentia?
6 An ens tanquam genus recte dividatur in ens reale
& rationis? ibid.
7 Quomodo ens reale & rationis sit definiendum? 32
8 An doctrina generalis de ente et rationis pertineat ad Met 33
9 An ens rationis habeat causam quarum vi existat, & quae
illa sint? ibid.
10 An omne ens rationis sit accidens, & quod sit illius subiectum? 35
11 Quomodo ens rationis recte sit dividendum? ibid.
12 Verum ens reale sit genus univocum entis increati
& creati, an analogum? 36
13 An solus Deus sit ens primum & increatum. ibid.
14 An ens recte dividatur in incomplexum & complexum? 37
15 An ens absolutum semper opponatur respectivo? 38
16 An ens recte dividatur in universale & singulare? ibid.
17 Quid sit ens universale & singulare? 39
18 An entia universalia sint aliquid extra intellectum? 40
19 Quomodo universalia vulgo soleant dividi, & quid de
illis divisionibus sit sentiendum? 41
20 An ens aliud sit permanens, aliud successivum? 42
De attributis simplicibus entium in genere:
ac primum de existentia, CAP. IV. 43
1 An ens, quatenus ens, habeat veras aliquas & positivas
passiones seu proprietates? 43
2 Quot sint pass. seu proprietates entis quatenus est ens? 45
3 An existentia differat ab essentia entis, & quomodo? ibid.
4 An omne ens quatenus ens habeat existentiam? 46
5 An omne ens habeat existentiam propriam? 47
6 An existentia unius entis possit alteri communicari, non
communicata ipsius essentia? 48
7 An unius entis una tantum sit existentia? ibid.
8 Verum existentia sit tantum entium singularium, an ve-
ro etiam universalium? ibid.
9 An sit discrimen inter existentiam & subsistentiam? 49
10 An dentur diversae species existentia? ibid.

page.notes: The number "582" at the top right is handwritten, so it is left out. The faint mark at the bottom right is a digitiser's stamp and is left out. Line 5: "m anere" has a gap after "m"; read as possibly "manere" with the stray letter, marked [?]. The number after "Met" on line 8 is copied as printed. The final line's page reference is partly cut off by the edge of the scan, and "ibid." is read as printed but may be incomplete.
